bad_request: need a session and a text
bad_upload: need a session and a small image file
bad_session: need a session and a short name
too_long: text is longer than the model can read
bad_login: need a user name and a password of at least 8 characters
not_yours: that session belongs to someone else
bad_memory: memory notes must be text, and shorter than the limit
bad_forget: that memory is not yours, or does not exist
